explanation.headline: Fosaprepitant dimeglumine is not on FDA's shortage list as of 2026-10-21; Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC posted a discontinuation on 2026-04-08

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list does not include fosaprepitant dimeglumine as of 2026-10-21.
Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC posted a discontinuation of manufacture for fosaprepitant dimeglumine injection on 2026-04-08.
Corvale East holds 94 vials of the 150 mg/5 mL presentation with 11.3 days on hand at current use.
Corvale General holds 166 vials of the same presentation with 18.6 days on hand at current use.
The label for NDC 16714024801 names Aspiro Pharma Limited in India as the registered manufacturing plant, last inspected by FDA with a VAI classification on 2023-08-11.
The rule-based best option is to buy from AVYXA Pharma, LLC, which is not on FDA's shortage list today, though its label names no plant we could place.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.

Decision on carboplatin: restrict carboplatin to curative-intent regimens while on allocation; oncology reviews each palliative order. Rationale: Two suppliers on allocation and under 10 days on hand at Corvale General (demo history). Approved by Jordan Hale, PharmD.
